The figures are notional and for billing purposes only. The scope mentioned in the Agreement shall remain unchanged. GST shall be paid on corresponding invoice value i.e., 77.5%.
Payment for work partially completed during the period shall be made on a pro-rata basis.

If any items/work is not included in the Billing schedule but is required for completion of the project within Battery limit as per contract , the same shall be completed by contractor without any additional price claimed to NMDC.
The Billing schedule shall be revised (maximum twice) during contractual period, if required keeping the total contract price unaltered.

As per clause 4.2 ( Page no- 6 of 238 ) under Commercial Contract Agreement , if actual quantities/ weights differ from the indicated , neither the contractor shall be entitled to get any additional price from  the Employer or  the Employer entitled to deduct any amount from the contract price due to variation in physical quantities/weight.
As desired by NMDC, the quantity and rate break-up has been indicated, which may vary during execution as per detailed engineering, while keeping the total amount shown against each item fixed.
Industrial building and Ancilliary facilties have been divided as per the list provided by NMDC through e-mail dt. 13.10.25
